marc:datafield.marc:subfield: "Computers are an integral part of everyday life, governing almost every aspect of our world today. But how do these powerful and complex machines actually work? In this Australian-made curriculum fit program we travel inside a computer to see exactly how computers work, and discover all about their history, language and technical components. Explained in clear, accessible terms, this program is suitable for novice and experienced users alike and covers everything from CPUs to peripherals, from the mouse to RAM"
